[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a detailed recipe for Pesto Cream Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes, including ingredients and instructions for both the pesto cream sauce and the pasta dish.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed ingredients for the Pesto Cream Sauce:  
- 1 cup fresh basil leaves  
- 1/3 cup pine nuts (or walnuts or almonds)  
- 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese  
- 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil  
- 2 cloves garlic, peeled and minced  
- 2 tablespoons unsalted butter  
- 2 tablespoons heavy cream (or half-and-half or whole milk)  
- Salt and pepper, to taste  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided instructions for making the Pesto Cream Sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided ingredients for the Pesto Cream Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes:  
- 8 oz (225g) linguine or fettuccine pasta  
- 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved  
- 1/2 cup pesto cream sauce  
- 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese  
- Fresh basil leaves, chopped (optional)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided instructions for making the Pesto Cream Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes.
